description: Adds Mermaid diagram and flowchart support to VS Code's builtin markdown preview
config.markdown-mermaid.enabled: Enable or disable markdown mermaid support.
config.markdown-mermaid.lightModeTheme: Default Mermaid theme for light mode.
config.markdown-mermaid.darkModeTheme: Default Mermaid theme for dark mode.
config.markdown-mermaid.languages: Language identifiers that should be recognized as mermaid diagrams.
config.markdown-mermaid.maxTextSize: The maximum allowed size of the users text diagram.
